tests.case: single-copy achievements remain visible without an identity relationship

FullscreenDetailsTests.Single_copy_achie.reason: Desktop and fullscreen native Details show the original single-copy 5/20 (25%) achievement progress while the relationship collection is empty. Progress is not gated on an edition group.

tests.case: fullscreen history initially focuses Lifetime and controller Right selects the original observed session

FullscreenDetailsTests.Per_game_history_.reason: The native fullscreen history opens on Lifetime. Standard-controller Right and Accept activate Tracked sessions; the original one-hour observed session produces one bar and the unchanged observed-sessions coverage note.

tests.case: fullscreen ten-repeat long title keeps every hero action above section navigation

FullscreenDetailsTests.Long_game_title_a.reason: The original ten-repeat title wraps beyond one line. Native geometry verifies every header action stays inside its hero and the hero ends above section navigation. The resulting 1920×1080 capture was inspected.

tests.case: reload preserves the local Journal section and an open unsaved editor

FullscreenDetailsTests.Reload_replaces_t.reason: A production bridge event reloads the library snapshot from Before to After while a real journal editor stays open with its unsaved draft. Closing the editor returns to the local Journal section; closing Details returns to Library. Both presentations dispatch no write when cancelling.

tests.case: a pending desktop journal prompt appears on fullscreen attachment and Back dismisses the shared prompt

FullscreenDetailsTests.Pending_session_p.reason: An ended-session event opens the shared prompt on desktop. Attaching fullscreen displays the existing prompt, controller Back dismisses it, and returning to desktop confirms the shared prompt is gone without a journal write.
